📊 FACT TABLE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Contains measurable metrics
• Granularity: One row per transaction
• Measures: Quantity, Amount, Profit
• Foreign keys to all dimensions

📋 DIMENSION TABLES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Descriptive attributes
• Who: Customer
• What: Product
• When: Date
• Where: Store
